family.description: This beta barrel domain is found at the C-terminal of S-methyl thiohydantoin desulfurase from Variovorax sp. (S-Me-THD) and similar sequences mainly found in bacteria and fungi. S-Me-THD catalyses the hydrolysis of S-methyl -thiohydantoin-5-propanoate into hydantoin-5-propanoate and methanethiol, the third step in S-methyl ergothioneine degradation [[cite:PUB00155448]].
family.name: S-Me-THD-like, C-terminal domain
